our_interpretation: The sentence firmly predicts a crash but presents its listed consequences as possibilities through 'may'.
Assess the firm crash prediction using the same ordinary reading as the other claim extracted from this sentence.
A severe crash means a broad collapse in the relevant AI sector with substantial financing, investment, or business disruption.
Do not convert possible venture-capital restructuring, hyperscaler damage, or social division into mandatory tests.
'I believe' is not an external condition that must occur before scoring.
criteria.support_condition: A dated, broad severe collapse of the AI boom establishes the firm forecast. Evidence of the listed possible consequences may describe its severity but is not required.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The absence of consequences introduced by 'may' cannot contradict the sentence. Continued prosperity for a finite period also cannot disprove its undated crash prediction.
